def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    border = max((v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if v != bg), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Fill only cavities bounded by complete, axis-aligned rectangular outlines.
    for r1 in range(h):
        for r2 in range(r1 + 2, h):
            for c1 in range(w):
                for c2 in range(c1 + 2, w):
                    if (all(grid[r1][c] == border and grid[r2][c] == border for c in range(c1, c2 + 1)) and
                        all(grid[r][c1] == border and grid[r][c2] == border for r in range(r1, r2 + 1))):
                        for r in range(r1 + 1, r2):
                            for c in range(c1 + 1, c2):
                                if grid[r][c] == bg:
                                    out[r][c] = 4
    return out
PY
